azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.description: Inspect a complete native Automation key-reference and attached system-identity declaration. Key existence, authorization, connectivity and cryptographic use are separate assessments.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.fail_observation: Automation declares a platform key, an explicitly incomplete key reference or no attached identity. Key use was not tested.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.missing_observation: Complete native CMK reference and attached identity metadata was unavailable, unsupported or unbound.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.pass_observation: Automation declares a complete customer-managed key reference and attached system identity. Key use was not tested.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.purpose: The reference selects the intended asset-encryption key.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.remediation: Configure a complete Key Vault key reference and attach the Automation system-assigned identity. Review key authorization, connectivity and key use separately.
azure.encryption.automation_cmk_declared.title: Automation declares a customer-managed key reference and attached system identity

azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.description: Inspect a complete native container-group Log Analytics workspace customer UUID and supported log type declaration. Workspace existence, access and log ingestion or delivery are separate assessments.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.fail_observation: The full container group configuration has no Log Analytics declaration or returns an empty workspace UUID. Log delivery was not tested.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.missing_observation: Complete native workspace customer UUID and log type metadata was unavailable, unsupported or unbound.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.pass_observation: The container group declares a Log Analytics workspace customer UUID and supported log type. Log delivery was not tested.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.purpose: Log Analytics settings identify the intended destination for container-group logs.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.remediation: Configure diagnostics.logAnalytics with the workspace customer UUID and a supported logType. Verify workspace access and log delivery separately.
azure.logging.aci_log_analytics_declared.title: Container groups declare a Log Analytics customer UUID and supported log type
